summary: Bullish filed a Form 6-K furnishing a press release and monthly metrics for June 2026 (trading volume, spreads, volatility) as a routine operational update for a foreign private issuer. No special-situation event occurred—no acquisition, divestiture, activist campaign, strategic review, tender offer, going-private transaction, capital return, spin-off, rights offering, restructuring, liquidation, delisting, issuer tender, deal termination, SPAC event, or forced management change. The filing merely reports standard business metrics; thus it is not a special situation.
